question: Which of the following government schemes was launched with the objective of delivering government services to citizens electronically by improving online infrastructure and by increasing internet connectivity?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Digital India.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The Digital India campaign was initiated by the Indian Government to make government services accessible to people electronically by improving online infrastructure and improving internet connectivity.**
 
• It was launched by** Prime Minister Narendra Modi on 1st July 2015.**
 
• Other government programs, including Make in India, Bharatmala, Sagarmala, Startup India, BharatNet, and Standup India, are beneficiaries of this scheme.&l
